svg.aria-label: How Savings works. Add money turns your USDC into nUSDC in the Null Collateral Vault. The nUSDC shares go into the Null Savings Vault, which lends them into the long markets, such as AAPLr | nUSDC, where Leverage Long traders borrow nUSDC against AAPLr. You earn two layers of interest, shown as AER.
